turns.content: A one-dimensional particle has magnetic-field profile Psi(x)=a^(-1/2) exp(-|x|/a) at t=0, with a=1.0000 nm. Derive the position probability density and identify how |x| simplifies on 1.5000 nm <= x <= 1.5001 nm.
Write the exact probability integral over that interval. Also give the narrow-interval approximation obtained by evaluating the density at the lower endpoint and multiplying by the width 0.0001 nm.
Substitute a=1.0000 nm and the interval width into the approximation and leave the result as an oscillatory phase expression before rounding.
Evaluate the requested probability numerically to four significant figures.
Compare the exact integral with the narrow-interval approximation and explain why their difference is negligible at the requested precision.
Report the final dimensionless probability for the position measurement and state whether this event is more or less likely than its complement.
